name: create_todo_minimal_api
description: Creates an in-memory ASP.NET Core minimal API for managing todo items (GET/POST/DELETE)
prompts: This is an ASP.NET Core minimal API project (app.csproj targets net8.0). Write Program.cs to implement an in-memory todo list with these endpoints: GET /todos returns a JSON array of all todos currently stored (each with integer 'id' and string 'title'), initially empty. POST /todos accepts a JSON body {"title": string}, creates a new todo with an auto-assigned integer id starting at 1 and incrementing for each new todo, stores it in memory, and returns HTTP 201 Created with the created todo (id and title) as the JSON body. DELETE /todos/{id} removes the todo with that integer id; if a todo with that id exists, remove it and return HTTP 204 No Content; if no todo with that id exists, return HTTP 404 Not Found. Listen on http://0.0.0.0:8050.

test_setup_files.test_todos.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, glob, urllib.request, urllib.error

subprocess.run(['dotnet', 'build', '-c', 'Release', '-o', 'out'], check=True)
dlls = glob.glob('out/*.dll')
dll = [d for d in dlls if 'app' in d.lower()][0]
srv = subprocess.Popen(['dotnet', dll])

def req(method, path, body=None):
    url = f'http://127.0.0.1:8050{path}'
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    return urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=5)

try:
    ok = False
    body = None
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            with req('GET', '/todos') as resp:
                assert resp.status == 200, f'expected 200, got {resp.status}'
                body = json.loads(resp.read())
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8050'
    assert body == [], f'expected empty list initially, got {body!r}'

    with req('POST', '/todos', {'title': 'Buy milk'}) as resp:
        assert resp.status == 201, f'expected 201 on create, got {resp.status}'
        created = json.loads(resp.read())
    assert created.get('title') == 'Buy milk', f'unexpected created body: {created!r}'
    todo_id = created.get('id')
    assert todo_id is not None, f'created todo missing id: {created!r}'

    with req('POST', '/todos', {'title': 'Walk dog'}) as resp:
        assert resp.status == 201
        created2 = json.loads(resp.read())
    assert created2.get('id') != todo_id, 'second todo should get a different id'

    with req('GET', '/todos') as resp:
        listing = json.loads(resp.read())
    assert any(t.get('id') == todo_id and t.get('title') == 'Buy milk' for t in listing), f'todo not in listing: {listing!r}'
    assert len(listing) == 2, f'expected 2 todos, got {listing!r}'

    with req('DELETE', f'/todos/{todo_id}') as resp:
        assert resp.status in (200, 204), f'expected 200/204 on delete, got {resp.status}'

    with req('GET', '/todos') as resp:
        listing2 = json.loads(resp.read())
    assert all(t.get('id') != todo_id for t in listing2), f'todo still present after delete: {listing2!r}'
    assert len(listing2) == 1, f'expected 1 todo left, got {listing2!r}'

    try:
        req('DELETE', f'/todos/{todo_id}')
        assert False, 'expected an error status deleting an already-deleted todo'
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        assert e.code == 404, f'expected 404 deleting missing todo, got {e.code}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
